## Purpose

Describe the user problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why a small documentation-only change does not need one.

## Verification

- [ ] Added a failing test before changing behavior or fixing a bug
- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] `Scripts/test_spm_consumer.sh` passes
- [ ] Updated documentation for observable behavior or API changes
- [ ] Updated the changelog when the change is user-visible
- [ ] Considered source compatibility
- [ ] Included no credentials, proprietary code, private endpoints, or customer data

## Notes for reviewers

Call out concurrency, cancellation, retry, security, or migration considerations.
